steps.text:
**Senior Network Engineer – Datacenter & Cloud Infrastructure** *Location:* [City, State] (Hybrid) – Remote options available *Company:* Probler – Leading provider of datacenter management solutions --- ### About Us Probler builds and operates world‑class datacenter platforms that power mission‑critical services for enterprises worldwide. Our technology stack spans high‑performance network fabrics, GPU‑accelerated compute clusters, Kubernetes orchestration, and intelligent monitoring/automation. We are expanding rapidly and need a senior network engineer to design, implement, and operate the backbone of our infrastructure. --- ### Role Overview As a **Senior Network Engineer**, you will be the technical leader for all networking components across our datacenters and cloud environments. You will design resilient architectures, automate provisioning and monitoring, troubleshoot complex issues, and mentor junior engineers. Your work will directly impact service availability, performance, and security for thousands of customers. --- ### Key Responsibilities | Area | Responsibilities | |------|------------------| | **Network Architecture & Design** | • Design scalable LAN/WAN, spine‑leaf, and fabric topologies for multi‑site datacenters.
• Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies (e.g., EVPN, segment routing, SD‑WAN). | | **Implementation & Automation** | • Deploy routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers (Cisco, Arista, Juniper, Palo Alto, etc.).
• Build IaC pipelines (Terraform, Ansible, Python) for network provisioning and configuration drift detection. | | **Performance & Capacity Planning** | • Monitor traffic patterns, latency, and packet loss using tools such as NetFlow, sFlow, Prometheus, and Grafana.
• Conduct capacity forecasting and recommend upgrades. | | **Security & Compliance** | • Implement zero‑trust segmentation, ACLs, and firewall policies.
• Ensure compliance with PCI‑DSS, SOC 2, ISO {{int:21600:32402}}, and other standards. | | **Troubleshooting & Incident Management** | • Lead root‑cause analysis for network incidents, coordinating with cross‑functional teams.
• Develop runbooks, post‑mortems, and continuous‑improvement plans. | | **Mentorship & Documentation** | • Coach junior engineers and interns.
• Maintain up‑to‑date network diagrams, SOPs, and knowledge base articles. | | **Collaboration** | • Partner with compute (GPU) and Kubernetes teams to optimize network performance for AI/ML workloads.
• Work closely with the security, DevOps, and product teams to align networking with business goals. | --- ### Required Qualifications | Category | Minimum Requirements | |----------|----------------------| | **Experience** | • 7+ years designing, deploying, and operating enterprise‑class networks.
• Proven experience with data‑center fabrics (leaf‑spine, EVPN‑VXLAN) and high‑throughput environments ({{int:8:12}} GbE, 40/100 GbE). | | **Technical Skills** | • Deep knowledge of routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, IS‑IS), MPLS, and L2/L3 switching.
• Hands‑on with network operating systems (Cisco IOS‑XR, NX‑OS, Arista EOS, Juniper Junos).
• Proficiency in automation (Ansible, Terraform, Python, REST APIs).
• Familiarity with monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, NetBox, NetFlow, sFlow). | | **Security** | • Experience implementing firewall policies, ACLs, and zero‑trust architectures.
• Understanding of compliance frameworks (PCI‑DSS, SOC 2, ISO {{int:21600:32402}}). | | **Problem Solving** | • Strong analytical skills; able to debug complex, multi‑layer issues under pressure. | | **Communication** | • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to convey technical concepts to both engineers and leadership. | | **Education** | • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). | --- ### Preferred Qualifications - Certifications: CCNP/CCIE, JNCIP/JNCIE, Arista ACE, or equivalent. - Experience with GPU‑focused datacenters or AI/ML workloads. - Knowledge of Kubernetes networking (CNI plugins, Service Mesh). - Familiarity with cloud networking (AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute). --- ### What We Offer - Competitive base salary + performance bonus. - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage. - {{int:320:482}}(k) match & equity participation. - Generous PTO and flexible remote work policy. - Professional development budget and certification support. - Cutting‑edge technology stack and a culture of continuous learning. --- ### How to Apply Please submit your resume, a brief cover letter highlighting relevant projects, and any certifications to **jobs@probler.com** with the subject line “Senior Network Engineer – [Your Name]”. We look forward to building the future of datacenter networking together!
